newsitem.title: CYPRUS: OPEC February output 26.69 mln bpd - MEES.
newsitem.headline: OPEC February output 26.69 mln bpd - MEES.

text.p: OPEC crude oil production rose by 140,000 barrels per day (bpd) in February to 26.69 million bpd, the Middle East Economic Survey (MEES) said on Monday.

"The February increase was for the most part attributable to increments of 50,000 bpd from Iraq where higher volumes were required to help reach the value target of $1 billion for the first 90 days of the U.N. oil-for-food programme due to a sales volume shortfall in January and declining prices, and a further 50,000 bpd from Nigeria," MEES said.
A Reuters survey put OPEC February output at 26.77 million bpd. The group has an official ceiling of 25.033 million bpd.
MEES put Iran's crude oil production for the month at 3.702 million bpd compared with 3.705 million bpd in January.
It said Iran's crude oil exports averaged 2.502 million bpd in February, a fall of 3,000 bpd from January.
